thread:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert: abnormal increase in kv-cache reuse errors and context cross-talk detected in eu-central-1. Metric kv_context_leak_rate > 5x baseline. Paging eng-runtime oncall.

jake: picking up. seeing burst at ~3187655030 with a cluster of 502s and trace ids showing mismatched seq_offset metadata.

priya: are there customer reports?

cs-lead: yes — 2 customers reported wrong conversation snippets appearing in other users' sessions. Tickets: CS-8532, CS-8535. They're blocked on privacy review.

marco: early read: this smells like KV reuse logic not clearing per-request paging state when continuous batching and page-fetch overlap. I can repro with paging_token churn + batch_size 4.

jake: repro steps please.

marco: run: `./tools/loadtest --profile paging-heavy --batch 4 --clients 50` then trigger concurrent page fetches. Watch logs for `kv_reuse: assigned seq_offset=... request_id=...` with duplicate seq offsets across request_ids.

priya: mitigation options? flip flag? revert recent batching tweak?

jake: quick, low-risk: disable kv reuse allocator in runtime: `--kv-reuse=false` and set continuous-batching max_delay to 2ms. This will trade latency and tokens for correctness immediately.

support-bot: drafting customer interim message: "We've discovered an intermittent caching issue that can cause context leakage; we are rolling mitigations now. We'll follow up with a postmortem and steps taken."

deploy-bot: prepare staged config change: `rdwctl config set runtime.kv_reuse false --region eu-central-1 --staged`

priya: can we scope to just the node pool where anomaly is highest? reduces blast radius.

jake: yes. target pool id rp-eu-3 (high error rate). I'll do 10% canary -> 50% -> 100%.

marco: adding a runtime guard as well — small hotpatch to validate seq_offset ownership before reusing an entry. Pseudocode: 

```
if (kv.entry.owner_request_id != current_request_id) {
  if (kv.entry.seq_offset != expected_seq) {
    metric_inc("kv.owner_mismatch");
    // allocate new slot instead of reuse
    kv = allocate_new_entry();
  }
}
```

marco: this prevents wrong reuse even if flag flip lags.

jake: timeline? canary now?

deply-bot: staged rollout to 10% started at 3187655038.

priya: monitoring dashboards: kv.owner_mismatch spiked after deploy job, but context_leak_rate dropped to baseline. Good sign.

cs-lead: CS notified affected customers at 3187655045. Also requested list of impacted sessions.

jake: canary -> 50% at 3187655054. No new customer complaints during canary window.

deploy-bot: rollback plan ready: `rdwctl config set runtime.kv_reuse true --region eu-central-1` and node restart if needed.

marco: I pushed hotpatch PR: https://git.internal/r/kv-fix/pr/452 — adds ownership check + increments `kv.owner_mismatch` metric + unit tests that simulate paging overlap.

priya: we should also run a short smoke that fuzzes paging tokens across 5k synthetic requests before enabling reuse. I'll kick that off in staging.

jake: request: add audit log of any sessions that showed leakage (scrub PII) and attach to postmortem. CS will need details for compliance.

cs-lead: on it. compiling session ids and timelines.

support-bot: interim update sent to customers at 3187655066.

deploy-bot: rollout to 100% completed at 3187655070.

marco: hotpatch merged and will be included in next runtime deploy. For now reuse disabled globally in eu-central-1.

jake: action items: 1) marco to land runtime guard + tests (owner). 2) priya to run CI fuzz job and report. 3) cs-lead to prepare customer communication & regulatory notes. 4) ops to prepare perf run to measure cost/latency impact of disablement.

priya: fuzz run started: expected 30m. will post results.

jake: tentatively closing incident loop once fuzz verifies and hotpatch lands. We'll reconvene in 1h for postmortem draft. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

cs-lead: adding timeline + customer notif to incident doc. Marking severity degraded to SEV3 at 3187655075.
